segments.text: Main character of Hakuoki Reimeiroku.
Although he's obstinate and badmouthing, he also has a gentle side.

After his mother died of illness, he lost his goal and wandered around aimlessly. He was raided by a group of sonnō jōi rōnins heading towards Kyoto, robbed of all his money, and left him to die. When he was about to starve to death, he was saved by Serizawa Kamo. In exchange for saving him, Ryunosuke is forced to become Serizawa's servant. The place he is taken to is the quarters of a group of rōnins who will eventually be known as "Shinsengumi."

Although he was also born in a samurai family, because of what he's been through, Ryu hates "samurai" with a passion. But now he lives with a bunch of youngsters whose lifetime goals are to become samurais. As stubborn as Ryu is, after getting to know them better, and understanding their dreams, his heart begins to change.
Source: MAL
Susumu Yamazaki is a proud warrior of the Shinsengumi, as well as a member of The Watch.
He is a diligent scout for the Shinsengumi, working in the shadows to obtain intelligence reports on behalf of Hijikata. He holds much respect for Hijikata for guiding the group.
Taken from official english site
A polite, well-meaning girl who met the protagoniste while in town. She is always looking out for the protagonist.
Taken from official english site
A young girl who isn't afraid to speak her mind. She works as a geisha in Shimabara, and despite her sweet exterior she holds strength inside.
Ryuunosuke's main love interest.
Chief of the Shinsengumi.
He is responsible for the Shinsengumi. Despite having great swordsmanship, he is very sympathetic and easily moved to tears. He believes a warrior's true duty is to serve the shogun.
Taken from official english site
The Shinsengumi's Colonel, and former Sendai Domain warrior. Sanan may smile and act politely to his men in public, but behind the scenes, he has no problem moving men with the coldness of his gaze.
Taken from official english site
A girl befrinded by the protagonist in Kyoto. She gets involved with the protagonist and those around her.
Taken from official english site
The oldest captain of the Shinsengumi, and leader of the 6th Division. He is a serius and sincere person, and he is favored by many.
Both Kondou and Hijikata trust him gratly since they are from the same hometown and school.
Taken from official english site
Member of the Wathc and the Shinsengumi's Corporal.
He observes the Shinsengumi members along with getting intel. He also serves as the Corporal of the 2th Division. He is the biggest man in the division and is very powerful.
Taken from official english site
A mysterious person hired by the Satsuma to attak the Shinsengumi.
He fights with only his hands.
Taken from official english site
A mysterius person hired by rhe Choshu to attack the Shinsengumi. He likes new things and uses a gun.
Taken from official english site
Chief's page and the protagonist's first student.

A young warrior whose pride drives him to become the strongest warrior he can be. After meeting Kondou, he is eagerly invited to join the Shinsengumi, and he eventually learns of the numerous secrets hidden deep within the group.

Sakamoto Ryouma is a former ronin of the Tosa Domain, allegedly cooperating with the Shinsengumi's enemy, the Imperial Nationalist party. Their fates become entwined as the revelation on the Furies comes to light.
Know for his stark realism and casual demeanor, Sakamoto prefers a gun over a sword.
Taken from official english site
Master of the Shingyoto-Ryu sword style.
His experience granted him the role of begin the shogun's guard among the Okuzune. He's know the Shinsengumi men since the Edo days. He especially respects Hijikata.
From official english site
Captain of the Shinsengumi's 5th Division.

His backgrounds in literature and military science give him the expertise to act as Kondou's consultant. The eventual arrival of Kashitaro Itou in the Shinsengumi threatens Takeda's position within the organization, driving him to leave.
Taken from official english site
The Shinsengumi's captain of the 9th Division.
He is the brother of Kashitaro Itou, and he joins the Shinsengumi at the same time as his brother.
He finds interest in the protagonist and picks on her. Together, he and his brother leave the Shinsengumi to form the Guardian of the Imperial Tomb.
Taken from official english site
Hatamoto of the Tokugawa Shogunate and a friend of Iba Hachiro.

His duties are of a clerical nature for the shogunate, and he does not partake or excel in swordsmanship. Because of this, he is somewhat intimidated by the Shinsengumi, and he only travels to Kyoto to accompany Iba.
Taken from official english site
A Shinsengumi warrior who joins them at the same time as Souma.
A student of the protagonist and a page of Kondou's. He is often eager to take action, and he has a strong distaste for people who manipulate or lie to others.
Taken from official english site
A former ronin of the Tosa Domain.

Nakaoka Shintarou is a longtime associate of Sakamoto Ryouma who cooperates with the Imperial Nationalist party. He has curried high favor among the Satsuma and Choshu Domains' elite, and he hopes to help overthrow the shogunate.
In many ways, he is the polar opposite to Sakamoto.
Taken from official english site
Shogunate palace doctor.
He works as a doctor for the shogunate western medicine in Nagasaki. He looks after the Shinsengumi under the shogunate orders. Supposedly he is a friend of the protagonist's father.
Taken from official english site
Military advisor and deputy commander of the Shinsengumi.

Head of the Guardian of the Imperial Tomb. Both his extensive knowledge of literature and his skilled swordsmanships resulted in his invitation to join the Shinsengumi as a key figure. He works as the advisor for Kondou.
Taken from official english site
A doctor practicing western medicine and the protagonist's father.
He was hired as the shogunate's doctor and was working in Kyoto, but is currently missing.
Taken from official english site
A geigi of Shimabara.
The Shinsengumi frequents her business.
Taken from official english site
After coming to Kyoto in search of her absent father, Chizuru stumbled onto one of the Shinsengumi's secrets, and was consequently taken under their "protection."
Once Chizuru's search for her father resumes, she begins to uncover secrets long buried. Secrets about her father, the Shinsengumi...and Chizuru herself.
Taken from official english site
Toshizo Hijikata is the acting commander of the Shinsengumi.

Know to his men as the "Demon Vice-Commander", he has a tough, disciplinarian nature. However, his thoughfulness and maturity make him stand out from the rest of the Shinsengumi, and he takes great pride in acting as a rigid foil to Kondou's lighthearted leadership.
Taken from official english site
Captain of the Shinsengumi's 1st Division.
Okita is considering to be something of a genius with the sword.
He like to make jokes—frequently at the expense of his comrades—and often wears a wry smile, but in battle he holds nothing back and his devotion to the Shinsengumi and Kondou is unparalleled.
Taken from official english site
Hajime Saito is a men of few words who acts as the captain of the Shinsengumi's 3rd Division.

Known for his lone-wolf nature, Saito is opposed to conversation he deems meaningless. He is a master of the sword-style iai despite being a lefty and is considered one of the best of the Shinsengumi.
Taken from official english site
Heisuke Todou is the youngest member of the Shinsengumi, despite begin the captain of the 8th Division.
He is know as an Edokko, meaning he is increddibly proud of his Edo heritage.
Heisuke's amiable nature makes him popular in social situations, reflected in his love of attending festivals around the country.
However, he can be a little hot-headed in battle.
Taken from official english site
He is the captain of the Shinsengumu's 10th Division.
He is easly agitated and prone to profane outbursts, but he is better known for his loyality and jovial nature.
Unlike many others in the Shinsengumi, his wapon-of-choice is a spear, and he is often tasked with guarding the rear units on the battlefield.
Taken from official english site
A mysterious warrior hired by the Satsuma Domain to attack the Shinsengumi. For some reason, he takes a special interest in Chizuru.
Taken from official english site
Shinpachi Nagakura is a native of Edo that is the acting captain of the 2nd Division of the Shinsengumi. He is passionate about swordsmanship, alcohol and women.
He is greatly opposed to dishonestry of all kinds, and his central ambition is to attain status as a true samurai.
Nakagura's swordmanship is generally regarded to be among the best in the Shinsengumi.
Taken from official english site
